verdicts.reason: A reflows into a sensible vertical stack (badge, headline, subhead, phone, CTA) and keeps the phone as the hero. But the cream circle behind the phone is left as a clipped fragment in the bottom-left corner, the ONLINE ONLY badge is jammed against the top-left edge, the subhead ends on an orphaned 'now.', and there is dead space below the CTA. B shrinks the phone, the key product image, to a tiny clipped sliver in the bottom-left corner, which ruins fidelity. It also leaves a large empty orange block at the top, floats the badge alone, and pushes the CTA to the left with nothing aligned to it, so the layout looks unintentional.
